scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n API,WEB -c blue,green "npm run dev -w @guigs/api" "npm run dev -w @guigs/web"
scripts.db:prepare: npm run db:ensure && npm run db:generate && npm run db:migrate && npm run db:seed
scripts.setup: node scripts/ensure-env.mjs && npm run db:prepare && node scripts/setup-state.mjs mark
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @guigs/api && npm run typecheck -w @guigs/web && npm run typecheck -w @guigs/shared
scripts.build: npm run build -w @guigs/api && npm run build -w @guigs/web
